turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, and my son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, so let's start there. Who decided, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
You're welcome. Now answer the question: who decided, and was Owen heard before that zero went in?
Owen is a great kid. Really bright, one of my favourites.
Then why is there a zero next to his name? Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided, and when?
I'm sure this is all just a misunderstanding.

"A misunderstanding." Okay, then withdraw it today. If it isn't one, tell me who entered that zero, on what basis, and why nobody called me first, because your own procedure 4.2 says you contact the parent before any mark goes in.
So can we agree he's a good student?
You're leading me, Hale, and I've done this for twenty years. His average is 91.2, and I'm not here to agree on adjectives. Who entered the zero, and on what basis?
